AgentIdentityResponse.description: Agent identity resource representing a digital identity for an agent to access external services

id.description: Unique identifier (ULID) of the agent identity

name.description: Human-readable name of the agent identity

description.description: Optional description of the agent identity

name.description: Human-readable name of the OAuth2 provider

clientId.description: OAuth2 client id registered at the external provider

authorizationUrl.description: External provider authorization endpoint URL (must be HTTPS)

tokenUrl.description: External provider token endpoint URL (must be HTTPS)

Oauth2ProviderResponse.description: OAuth2 provider resource. The client secret is never included for security.

id.description: Unique identifier (ULID) of the OAuth2 provider

name.description: Human-readable name of the OAuth2 provider

clientId.description: OAuth2 client id registered at the external provider

status.description: Lifecycle status of the OAuth2 provider. A status enum.

callbackUrl.description: Callback URL this service expects the external provider to redirect to

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the OAuth2 provider was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the OAuth2 provider was last updated

scopes.description: OAuth2 scopes to request for the machine-to-machine token

accessToken.description: OAuth2 access token issued by the external provider

tokenType.description: Token type as returned by the provider

agentUserId.description: The agent user id this 3-legged token is for

returnUrl.description: URL the user is redirected to after 3-legged authorization

sessionId.description: Server-side session id tracking this 3-legged authorization (optional)

customState.description: Opaque state echoed back on completion (optional)

forceAuthentication.description: Whether to force re-authentication at the provider (optional)

ThreeLoTokenResponse.description: OAuth2 3-legged token response. Either carries an access token (when 3LO completes) or an authorization URL + session to start the 3-legged flow.

accessToken.description: OAuth2 access token issued after the 3-legged flow completes

tokenType.description: Token type as returned by the provider

authorizationUrl.description: External provider authorization URL the user must visit to start 3-legged OAuth2

sessionId.description: Server-side session id tracking this 3-legged authorization

name.description: Human-readable name of the delegated API key provider

DelegatedApiKeyProviderResponse.description: Delegated API key provider resource (the actual key is supplied per-user, not stored here).

id.description: Unique identifier (ULID) of the delegated API key provider

name.description: Human-readable name of the delegated API key provider

status.description: Lifecycle status of the delegated API key provider

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the delegated API key provider was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the delegated API key provider was last updated

agentUserId.description: The agent user id this delegated key is retrieved for

returnUrl.description: URL the user is redirected to after authorization

customState.description: Opaque state echoed back on completion (optional)

sessionId.description: Server-side session id tracking this retrieval (optional)

GetDelegatedApiKeyResponse.description: Delegated API key response. Either carries the resolved API key (COMPLETED) or an authorization URL + session to start key retrieval.

apikey.description: The resolved API key value (present when status is COMPLETED)

authorizationUrl.description: External authorization URL the user must visit to authorize key retrieval (present when status is IN_PROGRESS)

sessionId.description: Server-side session id tracking this delegated key retrieval

status.description: Status of the delegated API key session (IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, FAILED)

name.description: Human-readable name of the API key provider

apikey.description: The actual API key value (treated as a secret)

ApikeyProviderResponse.description: API key provider resource. The actual API key is never included for security.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the API key provider was last updated

name.description: Human-readable name of the agent identity

description.description: Optional description of the agent identity

allowedReturnUrls.description: URLs permitted as return destinations after OAuth2/3-legged flows

apikey.description: The API key value provided by the user on the authorization form
